summary: Examples of set_stats: aggregating per-host package counts, global stats from templated values, and setting a non-aggregated stat.
questions: How do I count packages installed per host in stats?
How do I set a stat that isn't summed?

answer_card.title: set_stats examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.set_stats:
    data: {packages_installed: 31}
    per_host: yes
- ansible.builtin.set_stats:
    data:
      other_stat: "{{ local_var * 2 }}"
    per_host: no
- ansible.builtin.set_stats:
    data: {the_answer: 42}
    aggregate: no
```
